subject: gk
question: As per the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, which of the following best defines "electronic communication"?

options.text: Any information transmitted using electronic devices like phones or computers
Only video calls conducted through secure government networks
Verbal messages sent through written documents only

solution:
The correct answer is __**Any information transmitted using electronic devices like phones or computers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Electronic communication** refers to the transmission of information using electronic devices such as phones, computers, tablets, and other digital tools.
 
• It encompasses various forms, including emails, text messages, video calls, voice calls, and social media interactions.
 
• The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, recognizes electronic communication as a crucial element in modern governance and legal frameworks.
 
• This definition is integral for addressing cybercrimes, digital evidence, and ensuring secure communication practices.
 
• The use of electronic communication is pivotal in facilitating rapid exchange of information in today's interconnected world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Terminology:** Electronic communication includes methods like instant messaging, VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol), and file sharing over the internet.
 
• **Cybersecurity:** Protecting electronic communication channels from unauthorized access and data breaches is a key concern under modern laws.
 
• **Digital Evidence:** Data exchanged through electronic communication is often used in courts as evidence under cyber laws.
 
• **Data Privacy:** Ensuring that electronic communication complies with data protection regulations like GDPR or India's proposed Data Protection Bill is essential.
 
• **Evolution:** With advancements in technology, electronic communication has shifted from basic telephony to sophisticated AI-driven chat systems and blockchain-secured messaging platforms.
